outcome: Prevalence of premature rupture of membranes (PROM)
cohort: 242 patients with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) (36 conceived through IVF and 206 spontaneous conceptions) at Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Tongji Hospital, between 2019 and 2021
finding: ICP patients conceived through IVF had lower levels of transaminases and TBA, higher incidence of GDM and CS rates, but similar neonatal outcomes compared to those with spontaneous conceptions.
mod_finding: Cesarean section (CS) rates are higher in the IVF group (97.2% vs. 85.4%, p = 0.023).
